answer_1.quote: We employ reading data from the Eye Movements on Machine-Generated Texts Corpus (EMTeC, ..., an English eye-tracking-while reading corpus whose stimuli were created with three different large language models (LLMs) - Phi-2, Mistral 7B Instruct, and WizardLM - using five decoding algorithms... The generated stimuli belong to six different types of text categories: Non-fiction, Fiction, Poetry, Summarization, Article, and Key-word text.
answer_1.outputs: The paper investigates how different text types generated by LLMs influence human reading behavior, including eye movement patterns during reading.
